content: {"like":["Enjoys stylish, fashion‑centric dramas like *The Devil Wears Prada* for their timeless appeal","Prefers period pieces with authentic rural settings, such as *East of Eden*’s farmland realism","Values rewatchable classics that capture post‑war themes, e.g., *The Best Years of Our Lives*","Appreciates silent‑era dance and music integration in films like *Our Dancing Daughters*","Enjoys well‑costumed, light‑hearted romantic comedies set in exotic locations, e.g., *On An Island With You*"],"dislike":["Dislikes films that misrepresent their intended setting, as with *Summer of ’42*’s location choices","Criticizes weak character development and implausible plot twists in action‑adventure franchises, e.g., *Star Wars* sequels","Finds poorly choreographed musical numbers and incompetent direction off-putting, as in *On An Island With You*","Dislikes over‑long runtimes and lackluster pacing in modern workplace comedies, e.g., *The Internship*","Rejects repetitive, shallow romantic tropes in detective series, such as *Simon & Simon*’s endless mugging"]}
